text.es: Marta: Es un poemario de Rosa Chacel. Me lo leí en tu ausencia, y me dolió mucho no poder compartir contigo tanta belleza. He pensado que quizá ahora podíamos leerlo las dos. Fina: Gracias mi amor, claro que lo vamos a leer juntas, desde luego.
text.en: Marta: It's a book of poems by Rosa Chacel. I read it while you were away, and it hurt me so much not to be able to share so much beauty with you. I thought that maybe now the two of us could read it together. Fina: Thank you, my love, of course we're going to read it together, absolutely.
